text: I had a very disappointing experience with this law firm (Attorney Patino Rigo). My case was straightforward and not particularly complicated, yet they ultimately dropped it instead of helping me resolve it. I asked if they could negotiate with the other driver's insurance adjuster, but they told me they were unable to do so. I was expecting much more effort and communication throughout the process. I felt like my case wasn't given the attention it deserved, and I was left to handle everything on my own after they withdrew. Based on my experience, I cannot recommend this firm. If you're looking for an attorney who will actively advocate for your case and keep you informed, you may want to consider other options.

I usually don't give bad reviews unless merited but Thompson law had my case for a month and didn't pursue my case at all! Didn't submit a subpoena for anything nor did they file a claim with the other company. I've never had such a bad experience with a lawyer in my life. I will not recommend them to anyone unless you had a rear end case.

Having to send out a cease and desist letter to this firm for harassment. They claim their "investigation" found responsibility but with the wrong party in a multi-unit accident. All they would have to do is read the police report and contact the at fault party's insurance company that already accepted responsibility to determine this. I would be wary of hiring a firm that is this incompetent in their information gathering process. Obviously, they are not very good at their job.
